name: SerpApi
tagline: Real-time Google and multi-engine SERP results as structured JSON.
description: SerpApi scrapes and parses search engine results pages (Google and 80+ other engines) into structured JSON. It handles proxies, captchas, and rich SERP features so developers can query organic results, ads, knowledge panels, and local packs without building scrapers.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter (self-serve signup; key at serpapi.com/manage-api-key).

pricing.paid_plans: Developer ~$75/mo (5k searches); Production $150/mo (15k); higher tiers scale to 100k+; Enterprise available

rate_limits: Free: 50 throughput/hour. Plans under 1M searches/mo: hourly throughput ~20% of plan volume. Exact paid limits vary by plan.
use_cases: get Google organic SERP results for a keyword as JSON
check local pack / maps results for a business query
monitor ranking positions for SEO keywords over time
fetch Google Scholar or other engine results via engine parameter
power an agent with live web search snippets
